t_advice_summary_textbox.text: choose the gnome with the highest multiplier until it goes down, and then switch to the other gnome.

vb_textbox.text: Identify the gnome with the highest number of mushrooms, eg side K. If the multiplier changes to x5 then stay on side K. If the multiplier changes to x1, change to side S. If the multiplier stays at x1 then switch sides, but if it changes to x5 stay on the same side.
